name: Stream Encoder
description: An approximation of a compressed video stream: macroblock averaging and a smear towards the last frame that grow where the picture moves, banding in smooth gradients and chroma at half resolution.

params.label: Strength
params.doc: How much of the encoder's damage is applied; 0 leaves the picture as it is.

params.label: Blocking
params.doc: How strongly the picture is averaged within macroblocks; it grows with the motion in each block.

params.label: Block size
params.doc: The size of a macroblock in screen pixels.

params.label: Banding
params.doc: How coarsely smooth gradients, such as sky, are quantised into visible steps.

params.label: Motion smear
params.doc: How far moving areas blend towards the last frame.

params.label: Motion sensitivity
params.doc: How little change between frames counts as motion for the blocking and the smear.

params.label: Chroma subsampling
params.doc: Keeps colour at half the picture's resolution, as 4:2:0 video does.
